body:
Placing an order with One Stop Vape Store is straightforward, but it has more steps than a typical online purchase because vapor products are age-restricted and because several of our payment methods work differently from a card checkout. This guide follows the full journey of an order, from the moment you add an item to your cart to the moment an adult signs for the parcel. It explains what happens at each stage, what you need to do, what we do, how long each part takes and where to look if you need help. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Before you order: the basics
Everything we sell is for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive. You confirm your age when you enter the store and again at checkout. The minimum order is $100 before discounts, and orders of $200 or more after discount and before tax qualify for free domestic shipping on most of the 48 contiguous states; smaller orders pay the flat shipping fee shown in your order summary. We do not ship internationally. See [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/) and [where we ship and where we do not](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## Step 1: build your cart
Browse a category or search for a product, then open its page. Where a product offers options, such as nicotine strength or pack size, choose them above the Add to Cart button. The price updates to match your choice, and the choice appears in your cart and on your order. Set the quantity and add the item. You can keep shopping, and your cart is saved in your browser on this device, so it is still there when you come back. Check the cart page: it shows each line, the subtotal and how much more you need to reach the minimum order or free shipping.

## Step 2: enter your details
At checkout we ask for your name, email, phone and shipping address, and for you to confirm you are 21 or older. We use your email for confirmations and payment details, and your phone number so that we or the carrier can reach you if there is a problem. Use an address where an adult can sign for the parcel, because signature is required on delivery. Check the address carefully, because we cannot change it after the parcel is handed to the carrier. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/) and [why we need your email and phone](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/).

## Step 3: choose how to pay
Pick Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, Cryptocurrency or Gift cards. Cryptocurrency and gift cards give a 10% discount on the product subtotal, and the free-shipping check is applied after that discount. The order summary shows each method's total as you switch. Compare the methods in [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) and read [the 10% discount guide](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/) if you are close to the free-shipping line.

## Step 4: pay and confirm
How you pay depends on the method:

- **Cryptocurrency:** a payment window opens straight away with the amount, a QR code and the address. You send from your wallet and press "I have paid". See [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/) and the other coin guides.
- **Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime:** we email you the payment details after you place the order, with a link to a private tap-to-copy page. You pay, add your order ID in the note and upload a screenshot. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).
- **Gift cards:** we send a buy link and an upload link. You buy a card for the amount due and upload the details. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

Pay within 24 hours of ordering, because unpaid orders may be released so stock is not held indefinitely.

## Step 5: we confirm your payment
Crypto on most networks is matched automatically. Other methods are checked by a team member, which is quickest during business hours, Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 7PM Pacific Standard Time. When your payment is confirmed you receive an email and your order status changes to payment confirmed. Orders may also be reviewed for accuracy and security, and if yours is under review we will contact you the same day.

## Step 6: processing and dispatch
Orders have a processing time of 24 to 72 business hours, and most ship within 48 hours. Business days are Monday to Friday, and we do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays; your order continues processing the next business day. When your order ships you receive a tracking email with the carrier and tracking number. Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## Step 7: carrier delivery
We use regional carriers to deliver parcels, so transit time depends on where you live. Our published estimates are 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast (Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho) and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US. Weather, holidays and signature attempts can add days. Plan for the longer end if you are in the east, and order early if you need a product by a certain date.

## Step 8: delivery with adult signature
Federal rules require adult signature confirmation (21+) for packages containing vapor products. The recipient shows government-issued photo ID to the delivery employee. If no one is available to sign and the carrier returns the parcel, we process a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost, as described in the [shipping policy](/shipping/). See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) to prepare, and [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/) for what the parcel looks like.

## What each status means
Your private order page shows a status at each stage: awaiting payment, payment details sent, proof submitted, payment detected, payment confirmed, shipped or cancelled. Each is explained in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## If something needs to change
Contact us as early as you can with your order ID. Before the order is processing we can often update flavors, quantities and the address. After it is handed to the carrier we cannot. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## Where to get help
Use the support chat on any page, the [contact page](/contact/), WhatsApp, phone or email. Customer service hours are Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 7PM Pacific Standard Time. Include your order ID. If a confirmation email does not arrive, read [order confirmation emails not arriving](/blog/order-confirmation-email-not-arriving/). See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## Returns, refunds and problems
Returns must be arranged within 30 days of purchase, and opened or used e-liquid, devices and accessories cannot be returned. Refunds go back through the payment method the payment was received through, less a 15% restocking fee. Puffco products do not qualify for refunds or exchanges. If a parcel arrives damaged, photograph the items and the invoice straight away and email us. Read [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) and [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

## A typical timeline
Here is how a normal order might run. You order on a Monday morning and pay within an hour. We confirm payment that afternoon. Processing takes 24 to 72 business hours, and your order ships on Wednesday. The tracking email arrives, and if you are on the West Coast the parcel is delivered in 3 to 7 business days, so between the following Monday and the Monday after. If you are in the eastern half of the country, allow 11 to 18 business days, so roughly two to three and a half weeks. These are estimates, not guarantees, and signature attempts can add time.

## Tips for a smooth order
- Choose options on the product page before you add to cart.
- Double-check the address and use one where an adult can sign.
- Pay promptly and upload proof straight away if your method needs it.
- Keep your confirmation email and order ID.
- Watch for the tracking email and the delivery window.
- Contact us early if anything needs to change.

Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/), [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) when you are ready. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Do I need an account to order?
No. You can check out as a guest. Your cart and wishlist are saved in your browser on this device, and each order email contains a private link to that order, so you can follow it without signing in.

### What if I want to order the same items again?
Your order confirmation lists everything you bought, including the options you chose. Add the same products to your cart again, choose the same options and check out. If you are ordering regularly, our [bulk buying tips](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/) explain how to reduce your cost per item.

### Can I order for someone else?
You can ship to another adult's address, but delivery needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show photo ID, so make sure they will be there. Tell us in the order notes if the recipient's name is different from yours.

### What if a product is out of stock?
Out-of-stock products cannot be added to an order. If an item you want is unavailable, check related products on the same page, or contact us and we will tell you when it may be back.

### What if I am ordering for my shop?
Retailers can ask about wholesale pricing through the [wholesale page](/wholesale/). See the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) for how larger orders work.
